licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and slurs, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The German singing translation, instrument cues and the stage direction “Vorhang auf” are left out; the editorial [p] in bars 35–36 is entered as a plain p. Playback tempo ♩ = 123, from the lengths of four complete recordings (Jacobs, Harnoncourt, Muti, Böhm; median 1:59); Mozart gives the word Allegro only.
